_note: Print-only settings for the printable Community Health Profile (/print/neighborhood/[id]). Structure, order, section titles and indicator labels all come from the copy deck (content/copy/measure-copy.csv) — this file only holds what's different on paper. `indicators`: per-key print options — contextOnly (row shows □ instead of a ▲▼● comparison; an editorial call from the print mockup, not computed from higherIsBetter), displayAs 'topSegments' (show the top 2 distribution segments), unit (print-only caption), group (which At a Glance sub-group the tile falls under). `atAGlance`: the category title and its sub-groups, in order; keys without a group go in the first one. `insertBefore`: extra print-only rows that aren't in the sheet, placed before the named key. Rows in the sheet with no Key (NOT IN SITE measures) print as em-dash placeholders automatically.
